english:
[Music] First of all, let the name of God be glorified. My name is Rajamma. I am from Alappuzha.
I come from Nooranadu in the district. In this holy land where Mother appeared, she drew me close to her side.
For keeping me here, I say a thousand thanks to my Mother and to Jesus, and I now begin my testimony.
I was a wheelchair patient. My body had fourteen diseases, and I had undergone six operations when I came into this holy land.
I came here lying down in the train. From Adoor hospital, while sitting in my wheelchair…
…a girl brought me a newsletter, gave me also a normal medal of Mother, a tin of salt, a small portion of covenant oil, and she made the sign of the cross on me.
And so, as I was sitting in the wheelchair, from there through the government’s hand it was brought to my house. I placed that newsletter on my body, holding it close to my chest.
I felt I had received my Mother. I cried, saying, “Mother, I cannot come to your land.”
“How will I reach there? At least let one newsletter come into my hand,” I cried at my Mother’s feet.
I wept at her feet, pleading that somehow one newsletter would be placed into my hand.
Beside me, at my feet, my Mother gave me the newsletter, the covenant medal, the salt, and the oil that she had brought.
She gave me everything and blessed me.
I was a person who never went outside the house. They had to carry me lying down even up to Thiruvananthapuram in a car.
That same person today has received the health to run at any moment to this altar.
It is only through this Marian covenant, only through the precious blood of my Jesus, that I am standing at this altar today.
In that way, I lit a candle with the help of people walking on the road and prayed, “My Mother, let me be able to come to this altar.”
Carrying the Cross of my Jesus, stumbling and walking, I prayed at my Mother’s feet, “Release me from this state and bring me to your side.”
Around three o’clock, Mother brought me a packet of food, because I could not even afford porridge from the hotel.
The same me, who used to eat like that, was brought to this altar by my Mother and raised to this state.
It is only through one covenant that I am living today.
I, who once lived swallowing handfuls of tablets, until this day have not taken even a single pill again.
My Mother has not allowed me to take medicine for any illness. It is only by the blood flowing from the heart of my Jesus that I am alive today.
For this, I give countless thanks to my Mother and to Jesus.
In 2025, I suddenly had back pain.
After lifting a vessel, I developed a disc complaint. Gradually, from my waist to my big toe, the nerve became numb.
My leg became weak. It is with that same leg that I am standing here today.
With that disc complaint, I had severe pain. I could not sleep, I could not lie down — it was unbearable pain.
It was only by the precious blood of my Jesus that my disc was joined and flesh restored.
It is only by that blessing of my Jesus that I was healed.
For 20 years I also had a severe allergy. My eyes itched badly, water flowed from them, I could not open my eyes.
My whole body itched and burst open, and water oozed out.
I kept eating all the tablets and was exhausted.
Through this covenant articles, my Mother removed that allergy.
I also had a severe migraine headache for more than 10 years.
It was during the hot season of February that I came here and took the covenant.
In that scorching heat, standing outside, I came and took the covenant.
From that day until today, I do not even know when that migraine disappeared.
I have not taken any medicine. Without any covenant articles, only through the precious blood of my Jesus, my migraine was removed.
After that, I also had a lump inside my nose — a kind of growth.
When I prayed, water would flow from my nose, making it hard to pray.
I had to keep a cloth in my hand while praying. I said to my Jesus, “Jesus, Holy…”
Mother, I cannot pray. I am always sneezing and wiping. Please remove this from me.
Without me realizing, a miracle happened in my nose.
I heard a sound — like a humming tune — and then my Jesus came to me, touched me, and…
…at the place of the growth in my nose, when I took a breath, that swelling loosened, and like a little round ball that children play with…
…it came down into my throat. I always keep water near me while praying.
Except for my Mother’s covenant articles — salt and honey — I do not drink anything else. After prayer, I would easily take that water and…
…I prayed the Creed, saying, “My Holy Mother, my Jesus, let this water go down my throat and remove this swelling.”
When I drank that water, the swelling in my throat disappeared.
My Jesus appeared and removed the growth from my nose.
Since that day until now, I have never again had nasal blockage or any discomfort. I can now pray in peace.
I also had a lump in my groin. It was very painful. The lump was in the private part.
Because of shame, I never showed it in the hospital. I only applied covenant oil, making the sign of the Cross.
Only through the blood of my Jesus, that lump was miraculously removed.
Likewise, I also had a lump on the right side of my brain. It had been there for years.
I never went to any doctor for it. I simply anointed myself with oil and prayed.
I would pray, “Mother, do not let this spread in my body. Remove this through the covenant of my Jesus and Mother.”
And thus, even that lump in my brain was removed.
In the same way, I used to get infections in my mouth from swallowing tablets. My mouth would break out in sores.
I could not eat food.
I used to apply Mother’s blessed salt in warm water to my mouth, and apply covenant oil on the sores.
As a result, without taking any medicine, my mouth sores dried up.
Now I no longer get those sores inside my mouth.
I also had piles. When I took medicines for other illnesses, the piles worsened.
It became so severe that even blood would come out.
But by drinking the blessed salt water, I was completely delivered from piles.
I firmly believe, one hundred percent, that it was only through this covenant and covenant articles of my Jesus.
I also had ulcers in my stomach. Those ulcers too were healed through this covenant articles.
Then, on December 7 when I renewed the covenant with Mother, I received the blessing to carry it forward.
After that, I also renewed covenant, and the very next week, I received Father’s laying-on-of-hands service.
In that service, Father prayed by placing the Cross on my back.
From that day itself, I received healing from my illness.
In everything, through each covenant, I received blessings — in reading the Bible, in spiritual growth, and in healing of all my sicknesses.
All these are blessings given to me through this one covenant.
For this, I offer countless thanks to my Mother and to Jesus.
Spiritually, I also began doing witness work. Every week, Mother blessed me to come here.
I was someone who could not even get on a bus. But from the very next week after I took the covenant, I started coming here.
I had sorrow that I could not attend Holy Mass. I prayed, “Lord, let me be able to attend Mass.”
From then on, in the mornings, a vehicle would bring me to attend Holy Mass, to hear Father’s talks, and to join in adoration.
God’s grace was given to me in abundance.
In this way, Mother gave me every blessing. While doing witness work, I would also take newsletters every week. Even 50 newsletters in a single day were given to me…
At Kayamkulam and Arippatta hospitals, I used to deliver the newsletters before going home.
Every week, I would go to Adoor hospital, deliver the newsletters there, and hand over the covenant articles I had purchased earlier.
Before, I used to buy food from a hotel. But today, I have the health to prepare and pack up to 20 parcels at my own home and distribute them.
For this health, which my Mother and my Jesus gave me, I offer countless thanks.
What I want to say is—I am not worthy to stand in the temple of my God. I was a Hindu. I did not know how to read the Bible. I did not even know what it was.
For 15 years, a Bible had been lying in my house. On the day I took the covenant, that was the first time I touched that Bible.
From that day onwards, I began to read the Bible. As a Hindu, I prayed to Jesus, “I do not understand these words. Please help me to understand their meaning. Teach me the meaning. Teach me to pray with these words.”
As a result of that prayer, today, whenever a verse from the Bible is spoken here, I can look it up and pray with it.
My Father Jesus, through God, gave me that grace.
All the words that Fr. Joseph prays during worship, I too am able to understand in the same way.
Through Fr. Joseph and through the Bible, I have received this gift, and for that, I offer countless thanks to my Mother and to Jesus.
For healing me from so many illnesses, I offer endless thanks to my Mother and to Jesus.
I also go to the orphanage every month.
During Onam, I take clothes for them. The orphanage has 170 children. I provide them with a full meal to fill their stomachs.
One day when I went there, I saw they were given only two biscuits along with tea. My heart broke.
I thought, what will these little children do with just two biscuits? From the next month onward, I began to buy a whole sack of snacks and give it to them.
I give only from what God has given me. That day, I prayed to my Mother, “Mother, please give me four people to join me.”
As a result of that prayer, Mother gave me four or five people.
We formed a group, and now we also have a Rosary group. All of us come together…
Every month we go to the orphanage; we cook the food and together deliver it there.
For these blessings I offer countless thanks to my Mother and to Jesus. St. James wrote in his Letter, chapter 5, verse 16:
“Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective.”
In Rajamma’s testimony of this apparition, it is declared that Jesus has healed her of 17 illnesses.
This mother, who was once in a wheelchair, today loves Jesus strongly, serves Him, and—through the intercession of the Holy Mother—has done many things.
She has given us a powerful testimony.
For all the graces received from the Holy Mother, this daughter has come to the altar to say, “Thank you, thank you.”
Let us also surrender all our illnesses to the Holy Mother and pray to receive healing from Jesus.
Likewise, she used the covenant articles faithfully and activated them properly.
She testifies: “I used to take a whole sack of medicines; in return, I now give a whole sack of food to others.”
Rajamma testifies that as much as Jesus gave her, He also gave her the grace to give to others.
Today, at the Holy Sacrifice, Fr. Joseph told us that when you fill a vessel and pour it out, you will receive back—pressed down, shaken together, and running over.
Whatever we give, we will receive back in abundance; this is the great message we receive through every part of the Gospel.
Let us thank Jesus for all of Rajamma’s blessings and goodness.
Let us also unite our intentions with this testimony and offer a warm round of applause to Jesus and the Holy Mother as we present this testimony.
